notes:
- New perk, Heavy Handed (pink machine): melee hits 40% harder, and sliding into a zombie kicks it (80% of a
  melee hit, with a big shove; each zombie once per slide).
- Quick Fix is always in the spawn room (or the nearest room with space).
- Daily challenges: three new ones every day (the same for everyone), like "Kill 150 zombies" or "Upgrade 2
  weapons", worth 1,000 to 3,000 XP each. They're on the STATS screen and in the pause menu, with the time until
  the next ones.
- Players online: the main menu shows how many people are playing right now (bottom right).
- Audio channels: a new AUDIO tab in Settings with Master plus separate Music & Jingles, Weapons, Zombies,
  Effects, Ambience and Interface volumes (voice chat keeps its own slider on the VOICE tab).
- Bullet tracers: a bright streak now flies from the muzzle to where the bullet lands at bullet speed (hot head,
  soft tail), leaving a faint line of smoke. Wonder weapons and upgraded guns fire thicker blue bolts.
- Weapon name on the HUD: your melee weapon's name shows while it's out; names take your camo's colour, and
  upgraded weapons' names glow violet (that wins over the camo colour).
- Grips, magazines and trigger guards: trigger guards now hang from the frame and join the grip on every
  gun (they used to float). Moulded grips got textured side panels. The Mag-50's grip, wood panels and magazine
  line up (the mag used to poke out of the front), and the Hand Cannon has a proper wrap-around wooden revolver
  grip with a steel backstrap instead of a flat plank.
- Explosive weapons' camos unlock by weapon level (like melee): the Thumper, Bolt Thrower and Seal Launcher
  hardly ever get headshots. Camos you already earned stay unlocked.
- Fewer power-up drops: 2.5% a kill (was 4%), at most 3 a round (was 4).
- Boomstick and Twin Barrels: the stock's comb no longer fills the bottom of the view when aiming.

A full playtest checklist ran before this release: all 19 guns with every attachment and upgraded (about 470
combinations), all 4 melee weapons, grenade cooking, sliding, Quick Fix, Sir Chonk's fish, the special zombies,
15-round soak games on all 4 maps and every menu: no script errors.
